reviewer: Cursor coordinator and independent Cursor review subagent
text: Full retelling was checked against Frere's tale XXIII; chronology, eating counts, hour-long beating, ransom, three equal shares and ending are preserved.
Scene-5 dialogue was corrected so the demon's promise and the disobedience threat now match source logic.
Story is correctly placed at 16+ in adults-only chitrakathe, with no caste labels or softened ending.
Pause question now sits before the fall and does not reveal its own answer.
illustrations: Published 1024x1536 WebP contains six equal watercolor-gouache panels with stable character continuity and no text artifacts.
Panel fixes removed bindi from panels 1 and 6 and made the panel-6 bow visibly unstrung with no arrow.
The nose-ring shot, fall and hour-long beating are kept in text and not depicted visually.
No blood, graphic injury or death imagery appears in the final art.
limitations: AI-agent editorial review, not human Kannada-teacher or scholar certification.
Age suitability is an editorial judgement and has not been tested with readers.
Source fidelity was checked against the saved Wikisource transcription of Frere's 1898 edition.
Art was inspected as final sheet and panel crops, not inside responsive app layouts or dark mode.
